name: DeepWiki
description: Browse an auto-generated, interactive codebase wiki (DeepWiki-Open) inside a Cate panel. Auto-connects to a DeepWiki instance you're running (detected on localhost, or set DEEPWIKI_UPSTREAM), falling back to a manual URL prompt; code references open in Cate's editor, and Cate's AI provider keys are surfaced as a ready-to-paste .env.
